paper_metadata.title: Applying QNLP to sentiment analysis in finance

summary: The paper studies two gate-based QNLP approaches for finance sentiment analysis on synthetic ChatGPT-generated datasets of roughly 1000 sentences each. The QLSTM uses 4 qubits per QNN and 1 ansatz layer per QNN, reaching useful learning on the low-complexity set in about 20 epochs and on the moderate set only after about 100 epochs, while DisCoCat on the low-complexity set required 100 epochs and roughly 82 hours of CPU-based simulation time and remained only slightly better than random guessing. No quantum advantage over the classical LSTM baseline is demonstrated.

algorithm.variant: DisCoCat / compositional quantum NLP with lambeq and BobCatParser
algorithm.ansatz: Single-qubit words embedded with Euler parameterization; multi-qubit words embedded with IQP layers

problem_formulation.constraints_handling: classical post-selection on sentence meaning wire; wires 1 and 3 measured in |0⟩ state
